title: Scaffolded apps show the user, speak German and seed demo data as the real admin
detail: The scaffolded shell gets the signed-in user, the app mounts the German locale, and its kumiko.config.ts turns on requireFieldValueTranslations. A `SeedFn` receives `(stack, { admin })`: the seeded admin as a session user (first membership), undefined without auth. The scaffolded demo seed uses it instead of TestUsers.admin. `applyStandardBootSeeds` returns `{ adminUserId? }`.

title: New apps start on infra reusables v2.0.0
detail: The managed ci.yml gives the test job `contents: read`, `packages: read` and `pull-requests: read`, which the v2 reusable test workflow asks for, and kumiko-create writes kumiko.deploy.infraRef reusables-v2.0.0. Existing apps set infraRef to reusables-v2.0.0 and run kumiko sync-managed --write.

title: Live updates from a separate worker process reach the dev-server browser
detail: The dev server always used an in-memory SSE broker, so it never subscribed to Redis. When a separate worker process won the shared event cursor it published live signals to Redis, and they never reached the browser. The dev server now uses the Redis-backed broker when REDIS_URL is set, and setupTestStack accepts an optional sseBroker. Its channels are prefixed per boot (KUMIKO_REDIS_CHANNEL_PREFIX if set, otherwise derived from the dev DB mode), so parallel dev servers on one Redis stay apart; a separate worker must set the same KUMIKO_REDIS_CHANNEL_PREFIX (the handle exposes it as sseChannelPrefix).

title: Scaffolded bin/kumiko.ts dispatches events
detail: The generated standalone CLI now forwards `events` to `runEventsCli` with the app's features and row level security mode.

title: New apps start on infra reusables v1.2.4
detail: kumiko-create wrote kumiko.deploy.infraRef reusables-v1.2.0. With the 0.392 Dockerfile template that tag runs the frozen app-dockerfile guard, which rejects the secret mount, so a fresh app failed its first CI run. Existing apps set infraRef to reusables-v1.2.4 and run kumiko sync-managed --write.

title: The managed Dockerfile reads the registry token from a BuildKit secret
migration: Image builds pass the token as a BuildKit secret instead of a build-arg: docker build --secret id=npm_auth_token,env=NPM_AUTH_TOKEN, or secrets: npm_auth_token=... in docker/build-push-action. The infra _docker-build-push workflow already sends both. Run kumiko-upgrade --apply to rewrite deploy/Dockerfile; a Dockerfile with a kumiko-managed: local override changes by hand: drop ARG NPM_AUTH_TOKEN and ENV GITHUB_TOKEN and start the build-stage install with RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_auth_token,env=GITHUB_TOKEN bun install.

title: meilisearch lands in dist-server dependencies only when the bundle imports it or the app declares it
detail: The package stays external in every server build, but apps without search no longer get it as a production dependency in dist-server/package.json. An app that imports createMeilisearchAdapter, or lists meilisearch in dependencies or optionalDependencies, keeps it with the framework's peer range.

title: The managed Dockerfile names the real k3s migration step
detail: The comment above the migrations COPY in the managed Dockerfile pointed at a release.yml InitContainer that does not exist. It now names the migrate-db initContainer of the infra _app-deploy.yml, and migrate-step.sh for compose hosts. Only the comment changes; the next kumiko-upgrade shows it as a managed-file diff.

title: Scaffolded bin/kumiko.ts passes FEATURES from kumiko/schema
detail: The scaffolded standalone CLI handed allAppFeatures(appConfig) to runSchemaCli, a raw list without the bundled foundation. It now imports FEATURES from kumiko/schema, which the Schema CLI Features guard requires. Existing apps are not touched.

title: The dev server runs with row level security on
detail: runDevApp and createKumikoServer default to rowLevelSecurity "on" and run the dev stack as kumiko_app. On boot against a persistent dev database, the stack creates the role and transfers ownership of the database and of the public schema's tables, views and sequences to kumiko_app. The database user in DATABASE_URL needs the right to create roles, which the superuser of a local Postgres has. Code that reads tenant tables through a raw connection without a scope sees no rows in development; the boot does not detect this. runSchemaApply takes rowLevelSecurity, and the managed kumiko/schema.ts exports ROW_LEVEL_SECURITY from appConfig; the managed file updates on the next sync.
migration: Pass rowLevelSecurity: "off" to runDevApp while fixing code paths without tenant context; the dev database keeps kumiko_app as owner. A server entry written by an older scaffold passes appConfig.rowLevelSecurity to runProdApp by hand once the app turns row level security on. Manual migration, there is no codemod.

title: Scaffolded dev admin leaves emailVerified to the boot seed
detail: The boot seed marks the operator-created admin and the seed shortcut accounts as email-verified, so the scaffolded `bin/server.ts` no longer sets `emailVerified: true` on its own. Self-registered users still go through the verify flow.
migration: Optional. Existing apps can drop `emailVerified: true` from `auth.admin` in `bin/server.ts` and `bin/main.ts`; an explicit value still wins over the default.

title: Scaffolded apps pin Bun 1.4.4
detail: The deploy Dockerfile template, the managed public CI workflow and the scaffolded bun-types range move from Bun 1.4.0 to 1.4.4, the minimum the Bun.SQL driver needs. The managed CI workflow updates on the next sync; the deploy Dockerfile is only written at scaffold time.
migration: Raise BUN_VERSION in an existing deploy Dockerfile to 1.4.4 and bun-types to ^1.4.4 by hand.

title: Scaffolded docker-compose raises Postgres max_connections to 300
detail: Bun.SQL dials its whole pool eagerly, so the default limit of 100 is too tight for an app plus its tests. Existing apps can add command postgres -c max_connections=300 to the postgres service.

title: Fresh scaffolds build with bun run build
detail: create-kumiko-app now writes public/index.html with the /styles.css and /client.js placeholders. Without it kumiko-build stopped with a missing-template error, so the scaffolded Dockerfile could not build either.

title: Scaffolded apps get exact framework pins
detail: resolveFrameworkVersion no longer prefixes ^ and scaffoldApp no longer falls back to "*", so a new app is green in kumiko check managed. Without a resolvable version and without an explicit frameworkVersion, scaffoldApp throws.

title: migrate-step.sh leaves the managed file set
detail: Managed apps run migrations as the k3s InitContainer from release.yml, so deploy/migrate-step.sh is neither scaffolded nor synced for them. Delete it if present. kumiko-init-deploy keeps generating it for compose self-hosting.

title: English buildServerBundle errors
detail: The errors for a missing bin/main.ts and a missing bin/kumiko.ts in buildServerBundle are now English.

title: Named boot phases for the dev server
detail: createKumikoServer now reads as a list of phases: client bundles, Tailwind stylesheet, HTML templates, stack boot, background runners, fetch handler, HTTP server, shutdown, file watchers and signal handlers. Each phase lives in its own create-kumiko-server-*.ts file. Request routing is a route table instead of one if chain, and the file watcher classifies changes through suffix and directory tables. Responses, headers, cookies, the reload stream, log lines, exit codes and the start and stop order stay the same. PROD_BUNDLES_ENV, STYLESHEET_WATCH_ENV and resolveStylesheet are still exported from the package index.

title: runDevApp split into boot phases
detail: runDevApp() keeps its signature and behavior. Config resolution and boot validation (run-dev-app-config.ts), late-bound tier, session and token wiring plus the onAfterSetup step (run-dev-app-auth.ts) and the createKumikoServer options (run-dev-app-server-options.ts) are separate phases. Steps shared with prod come from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/boot/shared-boot-steps. A new unit test covers the late-bound tier resolver's boot-order guard and trialGate delegation.

title: runDevApp releases the KMS on any boot failure; server lockfile is verified
detail: runDevApp closes the KMS wiring when a boot gate throws before the server is created. Stopping one app no longer replaces the session, MFA and PAT revokers a newer app bound on the same feature instances: the bind functions of sessions, auth-mfa and personal-access-tokens return an unbind that only clears its own binding. writeServerLockfile replays the frozen install the runtime image runs, so a lock that did not re-resolve fails in kumiko-build.

title: Managed CI, app jobs and static config parsing
detail: The public ci.yml sets MEILI_URL and MEILI_MASTER_KEY for the Meilisearch service. App-owned workflow jobs with a trailing comment or a quoted name survive a sync. kumiko.config.ts with shorthand or spread siblings next to literal ports is read as defined instead of invalid.

title: runDevApp stop releases the late-bound revokers
detail: stop() swaps the session and PAT revokers that boot bound onto the auth-mfa, sessions and personal-access-tokens feature instances for inert ones, and those features now accept a new binding on a second boot instead of keeping the first. A later app or test stack on the same feature instances no longer reaches the closed database connection.

title: setupAppTestStack featureToggles option
detail: featureToggles true mounts the feature-toggles feature and binds it, so a disabled feature is unreachable in the test stack. It cannot be combined with effectiveFeatures.

title: kumiko check managed rejects loose Kumiko pins and a missing infraRef
detail: In an app, all @cosmicdrift/kumiko-*, create-kumiko-app and @cosmicdriftgamestudio/kumiko-* dependencies must be exact versions (workspace specs are allowed) on one version per scope. A private app without kumiko.deploy.infraRef is an error instead of a warning. In @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server, listManagedWarnings is now listManagedErrors and ManagedCheckResult.warnings is now errors.
migration: Pin the Kumiko dependencies without ^ or ~ and to one version per scope. Set kumiko.deploy.infraRef to an infra tag (reusables-vX.Y.Z) in package.json. Programmatic callers: rename listManagedWarnings to listManagedErrors and ManagedCheckResult.warnings to errors.

title: composeRendererStack forwards templateResolver options
detail: RendererStackOptions.templateResolver is passed to createTemplateResolverFeature, so an app can set tenantEditable.

title: composeSaasStack with stripe warns instead of requiring billing
detail: A stripe stack without the billing option logs a boot warning instead of aborting, and composeSaasStack takes featureToggles to require that option.

title: Managed workflows take infraRef, visibility and app-* jobs
detail: ci.yml and release.yml render the infra reusables as @<infraRef> from package.json#kumiko.deploy.infraRef. Without it sync-managed renders @main and kumiko check managed warns; this warning becomes an error in a later release. kumiko.deploy.visibility "public" renders a self-contained ci.yml and a release.yml that only prints the gh workflow run hint for the public rollout. Jobs named app-* survive a sync and are not drift. kumiko.deploy.docStatusGuard false renders doc-status-guard false.

title: ./testing subpath with the bound test stack and seed helpers
detail: setupAppTestStack, seedTenant, persistTenantRows and createE2eSeedRoutes, wired to the bundled user, tenant and auth features.

title: kumiko-build pins dist-server dependencies with a bun.lock seeded from the app's bun.lock
detail: The lock is written by writeServerLockfile after the bundle build and needs network or a warm Bun cache. The scaffolded Dockerfile runs bun install --production --frozen-lockfile in the runtime stage.
migration: Apps with their own Dockerfile should run `bun install --production --frozen-lockfile` in dist-server instead of `bun install --production`.

title: kumiko-build --entry and buildServerBundle extraEntries bundle additional server entry points as dist-server/<basename>.js
detail: Opt-in per file, not every bin/ helper module; the output shares the chunk files with server.js. Unknown kumiko-build options now fail the build.

title: composeGdprStack access, composePagesStack terms, migrate-step project name
detail: composeGdprStack({ access }) is passed to compliance-profiles and composeOpsStack({ access }) to delivery as their handler roles. composePagesStack({ terms }) is passed to legal-pages. DevHostDispatch and DevHostDispatchResult are exported. The migrate-step.sh template and the managed pre-push template follow the show-pony version, with the compose project name taken from docker compose config.

title: runDevApp binds the MFA token secrets
detail: When auth-mfa is mounted and JWT_SECRET is set, runDevApp binds the MFA token secrets the same way runProdApp does.

title: composeAuthStack, composeSaasStack and composeSecurityStack
detail: composeAuthStack({ sessions?, mfa?, accountSecurity? }) mounts auth-foundation and sessions, with mfa also auth-mfa and account-security; the password login still comes from the auth option or composeFeatures. composeSaasStack({ billing: "stripe" | "mollie", tiers, caps?, waitlist?, billingFoundation? }) mounts billing-foundation and tier-engine, cap-counter plus cap-overview with caps, waitlist with waitlist. With "stripe" the runProdApp billing option mounts subscription-stripe and the tier-sync webhook route; with "mollie" the stack mounts subscription-mollie from the mollie options and the app adds the webhook route. composeSecurityStack({ includeSessions? }) mounts sessions, crypto-shredding, rate-limiting and audit. composeGdprStack({ selfService: { userDataRights? } }) adds sessions, user-data-rights and user-profile in the order dsgvoSelfServiceFeatures used. billing-foundation requires tenant-lifecycle and compliance-profiles, which composeGdprStack({ tenantLifecycle: true }) mounts. user-profile in selfService requires user-data-rights-defaults and auth-email-password; composeUserDataRightsStack mounts the defaults, and the login comes from the auth option. Recipe: samples/recipes/compose-stacks.

title: Managed files: one template source for the scaffold, kumiko check managed and kumiko sync-managed
detail: deploy/Dockerfile, deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore, deploy/migrate-step.sh, .husky/pre-push, .github/workflows/{ci,release,cache-cleanup}.yml, the bunfigs and kumiko/schema.ts carry a kumiko-managed marker on line 1 (line 2 after a shebang or # syntax= line). kumiko new app writes them, plus kumiko.config.ts, bin/server.ts (was bin/dev.ts), bin/env-schema.ts, e2e/_helpers and src/__tests__/_setup.ts; bunfig.ci.toml is gone. kumiko/schema.ts is generated from kumiko.config.ts. kumiko-init-deploy prints a deprecation notice and goes away in the next release. Release targets come from package.json#kumiko.deploy.namespace and .deployment (default: the app name).
migration: Existing apps: add kumiko.config.ts with defineAppConfig, then run kumiko sync-managed (dry run), kumiko sync-managed --write --adopt for files that are identical or should follow the template, and mark deliberate deviations with "# kumiko-managed: local <reason>" on line 2. Until kumiko.config.ts calls defineAppConfig, kumiko check only warns about drift and missing scripts.

title: @app/define and kumiko codegen are removed
detail: The .kumiko/ codegen (define.ts, types.generated.d.ts, schemas.generated.ts) is gone: runCodegen, scanEvents and their types are no longer exported, the dev server no longer watches r.defineEvent calls, `kumiko codegen` is removed, `kumiko-build --check` is removed and kumiko-build no longer runs a codegen pass. The scaffolded .gitignore no longer lists .kumiko/, so the upgrade marker .kumiko/upgrade-state.json can be committed. ctx.appendEvent stays bound to the augmentable KumikoEventTypeMap; to emit an event with a payload checked against its definition use emitEvent(ctx, eventDef, { aggregateId, aggregateType, payload, headers? }) with the EventDef that r.defineEvent returns (emitEvent now also accepts headers).
migration: Replace `@app/define` imports with direct framework imports (defineWriteHandler/defineQueryHandler/defineFeature from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine, events via r.defineEvent and emitEvent) and drop the `file:./.kumiko` dependency plus the bunfig/tsconfig resolver entries. Known sites: publicstatus 43 files, kumiko-platform 13 (samples), solon 3, money-horse 1, phronexsis 1.

title: Scaffolded apps get AGENTS.md from a template with placeholders
detail: The scaffold renders AGENTS.md from templates/AGENTS.app.md instead of a fixed string. It fills in the app name, the mounted features and the commands that exist in the generated package.json. Purpose, production URL and app-specific rules stay as visible TODO(app owner) placeholders. CLAUDE.md is unchanged: it imports the framework guide and AGENTS.md.

title: New projects read the prod admin password from DEMO_ADMIN_PASSWORD
detail: The scaffolded bin/main.ts no longer seeds the prod admin with a fixed password. It reads DEMO_ADMIN_PASSWORD (declared in the env schema, min 12 chars), and boot fails without it. Existing apps are untouched; apps from an older scaffold should change bin/main.ts the same way.

title: A freshly scaffolded app passes bun run lint without rework
detail: New projects now get a .gitignore, an exactly pinned @biomejs/biome and lint-clean generated files (import order, formatting). Existing apps are untouched.

title: composeRendererStack passes a mail brand suffix resolver
detail: composeRendererStack({ mailBrandSuffix }) hands the resolver to createRendererMailHtmlFeature as brandSuffix.

title: composeRendererStack passes a mail footer resolver to the mail renderer
detail: composeRendererStack({ mailFooter }) hands the resolver to createRendererMailHtmlFeature, so apps on the composed stack set imprint, privacy and platform line in one place.

title: The kumiko-schema-check bin and the resolveGeneratePath, usesDerivedSchemaLayout and implicitAuthModeFeatureNames exports are removed
detail: kumiko-schema-check diffed APP_FEATURES against a hand-kept FEATURE_IMPORT_REGISTRY. Apps with kumiko/schema.ts derive their entities from the mounted features and have no registry that could drift, so the check was a no-op there. The helpers resolveGeneratePath, usesDerivedSchemaLayout and implicitAuthModeFeatureNames are no longer exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/cli.
migration: Apps with kumiko/schema.ts need nothing. Run kumiko-schema validate to check migrations against the mounted features, and remove kumiko-schema-check from package scripts and CI. Apps that keep a FEATURE_IMPORT_REGISTRY diff it against APP_FEATURES in their own coverage script.

title: buildServerBundle resolves worker and bootstrap entries as .ts or .js; runDevApp stop keeps an explicit blindIndexKey
detail: An app with bin/main.js and bin/worker.js used to get no dist-server/worker.js without any warning, because only worker.ts and bootstrap.ts were looked up. Siblings now resolve like the server entry, .ts first and then .js. In the ephemeral PII default, stopping runDevApp unset a blindIndexKey that the app passed itself; it now unsets only the key the default generated.

title: runDevApp resolves the masterKey provider before boot validation
detail: runDevApp validated encrypted fields before building the boot cipher, so an app that supplies masterKey and has no KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1 in the environment booted in production but failed locally with no usable master key. The provider now reaches validateBoot like in runProdApp and runWorkerApp.

title: composeRendererStack includes renderer-mail-html
detail: The renderer stack now also mounts createRendererMailHtmlFeature, which the auth mails need. Apps that already list renderer-mail-html next to composeRendererStack() drop their own copy, createRegistry rejects duplicate features.

title: composeRendererStack no longer mounts renderer-simple
detail: renderer-simple is removed, so the renderer stack is template-resolver, renderer-foundation and renderer-mail-html.

title: runDevApp encrypts PII on ephemeral dev DBs by default
detail: Without a kms option, runDevApp now configures an InMemoryKmsAdapter and a random blind-index key when KUMIKO_DEV_DB_NAME is unset. With a persistent dev DB nothing changes (plaintext plus warning, pass createPgKmsAdapter to encrypt). RunDevAppOptions.kms also accepts false for explicit plaintext. An app-provided kms keeps its previous behavior, including the boot abort for lookupable fields without a blindIndexKey.
migration: e2e or dev scripts that read PII columns raw must decrypt them or pass kms false to runDevApp. Apps that pass their own kms are unaffected.

title: Dev boot passes Redis to the delivery service so notify idempotencyKey dedupes
migration: No action needed.

title: init-deploy fails early when private GitHub packages have no bunfig.toml or .npmrc
detail:
init-deploy rejects private GitHub packages without a registry config
An app with `@cosmicdriftgamestudio/*` dependencies but no `bunfig.toml`/`.npmrc` used to get a Dockerfile whose `bun install` failed with a 404 only inside the image build. `scaffoldDeploy`, `renderDeployFiles` and `checkDeployDrift` now throw with a hint to add the scope entry.

title: Deploy scaffold warnings distinguish broken package.json from unexpected dependency shapes
--help prints usage instead of running the command (init-deploy, build, dev, schema-check, kumiko-testing integration)
detail:
`--help` prints usage on every bin
`kumiko-init-deploy --help` used to write the deploy files, and `kumiko-testing integration --help` crashed while parsing its arguments. Both now print their usage and exit 0, as do `kumiko-build`, `kumiko-dev`, `kumiko-schema-check` and `create-kumiko-app`.

title: init-deploy reads kumiko.deploy.dbName for the migrate step's DATABASE_URL
detail:
init-deploy: `package.json#kumiko.deploy.dbName`
`migrate-step.sh` builds `DATABASE_URL` with `kumiko.deploy.dbName` as the database (default: appName), validated like `dbUser`. Apps without the key render byte-identical output.

title: Dev-server file watchers take an injectable event source so watcher tests no longer depend on FSEvents timing
detail:
Dev-server file watchers accept an injected event source
`watchAndRegenerate` takes `watchDirectory` and `createKumikoServer` takes `_watchDirectory`. Production behavior is unchanged (native `fs.watch`); the hot-reload and codegen-watch tests drive changes through the seam instead of macOS FSEvents, which starts asynchronously and drops early writes.

title: generated migrate-step.sh honours COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME from .env
detail: The `migrate-step.sh` that `kumiko-init-deploy` generates now reads `.env` before it picks the stack network. Before, a `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME` set only in `.env` was ignored and the script fell back to the directory name, so on a shared host it could run the migration against another app's network and Postgres. The project name, from `.env` or the directory, is lowercased and stripped to `[a-z0-9_-]` as Compose does, and the script still stops when the network does not exist. Regenerate the script in existing apps to pick this up.

title: Client entry edits hot-reload instead of restarting
detail:
Editing a client entry file hot-reloads instead of restarting the dev server
On macOS the recursive file watcher reports paths relative to the watched directory. A change to a client entry such as `client.tsx` or a custom-named entry was therefore classified as a server change and restarted the process. The watcher now resolves the path and treats every configured entry source file as hot-reload.

title: buildServerBundle bundles bin/bootstrap.ts to dist-server/bootstrap.js when present
Codegen watcher change filter is a tested pure predicate
Deploy migrate-step.sh always uses the exact stack network
detail: The discover variant (docker network ls | head -1) could pick another compose project's network on a shared host. The script now uses COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME or the directory name plus _stack.
migration: Remove package.json kumiko.deploy.stackNetwork (or set it to "directory"), then re-run scaffoldDeploy. If the deploy directory name differs from the compose project, set COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME for migrate-step.sh.

title: Server bundle includes an optional worker entry
detail: When `bin/worker.ts` sits next to `bin/main.ts`, `buildServerBundle` builds it in the same split build as `dist-server/worker.js`. Start a separate worker process from the same image with `exec bun run worker.js`.

title: Scaffolded migrate step percent-encodes DB_PASSWORD
detail: dev-server: the scaffolded `deploy/migrate-step.sh` percent-encodes `DB_PASSWORD` in `DATABASE_URL`, so passwords with `@`, `:`, `/`, `#`, `%` or non-ASCII characters no longer break the URL. Re-run `kumiko init-deploy` to pick it up; apps with a hand-written `urlencode` should take the new version, which also encodes bytes >= 0x80 correctly.

title: dev hostDispatch not-found can serve a custom 404 page
detail: `DevHostDispatchResult` `{ kind: "not-found" }` accepts `file` (served like `static-html`) or `entryName` (that entry's shell), both with status 404. A missing file answers 500 with `hostDispatch: file not found`. Without fields the plain "Not Found" 404 stays.
migration: No code change needed.

title: New package @cosmicdrift/kumiko-samples with the corpus sources
detail:
New package with the sample recipes, sample apps and bundled-features sources
`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-samples` ships the sample recipes, sample apps and bundled-features sources in the repository layout. Tools such as the few-shot corpus build can run against a pinned version of it and get the same entry ids and source paths as in the monorepo.

title: createKumikoServer handle exposes the boot's jobQueueNamePrefix
detail: dev-server: `createKumikoServer()` returns the boot's `jobQueueNamePrefix` on its handle, so callers sharing a Redis can address exactly that boot's `bull:<prefix>-*` keys.
migration: No action needed: purely additive handle field.

title: public/ served via realpath incl. symlinked public/, ephemeral dev queues cleaned on stop, init-deploy --out app name, compose-style migrate-step network name, config preset validates configResolver; guards report correct isolation lines and time out kumiko-upgrade
detail: The dev server serves `public/` files from the symlink-resolved path (realpath check before the read) and works when `public/` itself is a symlink. Ephemeral dev boots delete their per-boot BullMQ keys from the shared Redis on `stop()`. `kumiko-init-deploy --out <dir>` defaults the app name from that directory's `package.json`. The generated `migrate-step.sh` with `stackNetwork: "directory"` derives the network name like Docker Compose (lowercased, sanitised, `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME` wins). `setupTestStackFromFeatures` with the `config` preset throws a clear error when `extraContext.configResolver` is not a resolver. The runtime-isolation guard reports each regression at its own import line, and the upgrade-state guard no longer hangs on a stuck `kumiko-upgrade` (stdin ignored, timeout).

title: Codegen validates feature-manifest.json and only keeps the stale handler block when it is missing or invalid
detail: `kumiko-build` codegen now validates `feature-manifest.json`. A valid manifest that lists no write handlers removes the generated `WriteHandlerQn` and typed-dispatcher block instead of keeping a stale one. A broken manifest keeps the block and warns with its own "feature-manifest.json invalid" message.

title: Codegen emits namespace zod imports
detail: Generated `schemas.generated.ts` and `types.generated.d.ts` now import zod as a namespace (`import * as z from "zod"`), matching the framework's own convention. Regenerate with `kumiko build` to pick it up.

title: Dev public-file fallback returns 404 for NUL or over-long paths, deploy scaffold blames appName for an invalid default DB user
detail: The dev-server public-file fallback answers a request path containing an encoded NUL byte (`%00`) or an over-long file name with the normal 404 instead of a 500. The scaffold deploy step now names `appName` as the cause when it is too long to serve as the default DB user.

title: kumiko-server-runtime and kumiko-dev-server are published as compiled JavaScript plus .d.ts
detail: Both packages now ship `dist` (`.js` and `.d.ts`) instead of TypeScript source. Export keys are unchanged; only the targets behind them move to `dist`. `kumiko-dev-server` keeps its `bin/*.ts` entrypoints (they still need Bun) and ships them together with `templates`; they now import through the new `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/cli` export instead of reaching into `src`. `kumiko-server-runtime` now declares `ioredis` and `kumiko-dev-server` declares `zod` as dependencies, which their code already imported. `ioredis` is imported as a named `{ Redis }` so the class resolves under Node's ESM loader.

title: Dev server serves the renderer-web fonts
detail: GET `/assets/kumiko/fonts/<file>.woff2` streams the packaged IBM Plex files with `font/woff2` and a one day cache header. Names outside the allowlist answer 404.

title: Deploy Dockerfile template: NPM_AUTH_TOKEN registry auth, manifest-first or full-tree install by detected layout, BUILD_VERSION/BUILD_TIME in the runtime stage, TZ=UTC; new kumiko-init-deploy bin with --force and a --check drift check
migration:
The scaffolded `deploy/Dockerfile` now declares `ARG NPM_AUTH_TOKEN`
(global + re-declared in the build stage) instead of `ARG GITHUB_TOKEN`,
and exports `ENV GITHUB_TOKEN=${NPM_AUTH_TOKEN}` in the build stage —
bunfig.toml/.npmrc still read `$GITHUB_TOKEN`, only the build-arg name
passed by CI changes. Apps that already generated `deploy/Dockerfile`
from an older template keep working unchanged; re-run
`kumiko-init-deploy --force` (or `kumiko init-deploy --force` from the
monorepo) to pick up the new wiring, the runtime stage's
`ARG BUILD_VERSION=dev`/`ARG BUILD_TIME=unknown` re-declaration (without
it the runtime `ENV BUILD_VERSION`/`ENV BUILD_TIME` stayed empty despite
a correct `--build-arg`), and `ENV TZ=UTC`.

The install step now copies manifests first (`package.json`, `bun.lock`,
and whichever of `bunfig.toml`/`.npmrc` exist) before `bun install`,
unless the app's `package.json` has a `workspaces` field or a
`file:`/`workspace:`/`link:` dependency spec, in which case it still
does `COPY . .` first (bun needs the whole tree to resolve the
lockfile).

`scaffoldDeploy`/`ScaffoldDeployOptions`/`ScaffoldDeployResult` keep
their existing shape and behavior. New: `renderDeployFiles` (pure,
no writes) and `checkDeployDrift` (read-only, reports missing/differing
files) are exported alongside `scaffoldDeploy`, which now calls
`renderDeployFiles` internally. `ScaffoldDeployDetected` gained
`installFromFullTree` and `registryConfigFiles`.

New `kumiko-init-deploy` bin (and `runInitDeployCli` export) — same
flags as `kumiko init-deploy` (`--app`, `--port`, `--github-org`,
`--out`, `--force`), plus `--check` (drift check, exit 1 on any
missing/differing file, does not write) and defaulting `--app` from
`package.json`'s `name` (scope stripped) when omitted. `--check` and
`--force` are mutually exclusive (exit 2). The monorepo's
`kumiko init-deploy` command now delegates to `runInitDeployCli`
instead of duplicating the CLI logic.

title: migrate-step.sh reads package.json#kumiko.deploy (dbUser, stackNetwork "discover" | "directory"); defaults unchanged, invalid values fail the render and the drift check
migration:
No action needed: without `kumiko.deploy` the scaffolded
`deploy/migrate-step.sh` renders byte-identical to before. Apps whose
database user is not the app name set
`"kumiko": { "deploy": { "dbUser": "<user>" } }`; apps that want the
exact `<dirname>_stack` network instead of the `docker network ls`
heuristic set `"stackNetwork": "directory"`. Both `kumiko-init-deploy
--force` and `--check` read the same config, so the drift check needs
no extra flags. `ScaffoldDeployDetected` gained `dbUser` and
`stackNetwork`.

title: runDevApp wires auth-email-password's new invite-info query into invite.infoHandler
detail: Same wiring as runProdApp, for the dev server.
migration: No action needed: purely additive wiring, no option changes.

title: kumiko-build reads client entries from package.json "kumiko.clientEntries"/"kumiko.clientEntry" instead of inferring them from filenames
detail:
`kumiko-build` (and the `kumiko build` command) now call
`readClientEntriesConfig(cwd)` and pass the result into
`buildProdBundle`, instead of relying on `discoverClientEntries`'
filename-based multi-entry discovery. `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/build`
re-exports `resolveClientEntries`, `readClientEntriesConfig`, and
`ClientEntryDeclaration` in place of `discoverClientEntries`.
migration:
See the `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime` changelog entry above for
the required package.json changes — the dev-server change is the CLI
wiring for the same underlying behavior.

title: kumiko-upgrade gained --help/-h
detail: Prints usage and exits 0 without running the upgrade report.
migration: No action needed.

title: runDevApp now also honors KUMIKO_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS as an env fallback, symmetric to runProdApp
detail:
Precedence: `options.trustedProxyHops ?? effectiveAuth?.trustedProxyHops
?? parseTrustedProxyHopsEnv(envSource[TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS_ENV], "runDevApp")`.
migration: No action needed for the default (unproxied) dev setup.

title: createKumikoServer/runDevApp gained a trustedProxyHops option
detail:
`CreateKumikoServerOptions`/`RunDevAppOptions` gained a top-level
`trustedProxyHops`, forwarded into `setupTestStack`'s `buildServer` call.
Dev normally runs unproxied, so this is usually left unset (default 0).
migration:
No action needed for the default (unproxied) dev setup. Set
`trustedProxyHops` only if you run the dev server behind a reverse proxy.

title: setupTestStackFromFeatures' config preset now also derives _configAccessorFactory
detail: buildHandlerContext derives ctx.config from _configAccessorFactory, not configResolver directly, so a write handler under presets: ["config"] saw ctx.config as undefined even with a configResolver present. mergeExtraContext now also runs addConfigAccessorFactory (the same helper runProdApp/runDevApp use), keeping a base-supplied configResolver winning over the preset default. Closes #3313.

title: Dev-server HTML no longer injects __KUMIKO_SCHEMA__ either
migration:
Same semantics as the prod change: `DevHostDispatchResult.injectSchema`
is deprecated and ignored. The dev-server's auto-mint mode still sets
the `kumiko_auth`/`kumiko_csrf` cookies on the HTML response, so a
client-side fetch to `/api/schema` is authenticated immediately without
a real login round-trip.

title: Dev server can build prod-shaped client bundles, E2E uses them
Dev-server job queues no longer collide across parallel boots
createKumikoServer/runDevApp gain stylesheetWatch (env KUMIKO_DEV_STYLESHEET_WATCH=0) to build Tailwind CSS once without a --watch process
detail: `defineAppE2eConfig` sets `KUMIKO_DEV_STYLESHEET_WATCH=0`, so the dev-server it boots builds CSS once and stops instead of keeping a Tailwind `--watch` process alive. Tailwind v4's watcher subscribes to the whole app cwd recursively with no gitignore filter, so every Playwright artifact write under `test-results/` previously counted as a rebuild trigger.

title: Scaffolded bunfig.toml and bunfig.ci.toml no longer contain the inert [test] concurrency key
detail: bun has no [test] concurrency key and ignores it silently; the scaffold wrote concurrency = 8, which made kumiko-testing bunfig refuse the merge on a freshly scaffolded app. Existing apps can delete the line from their bunfig files; nothing changes at runtime.

title: Scaffolded docker-compose.yml uses the correct Postgres 18 data path; default app mounts auth-foundation so it boots
migration: No action needed for existing apps; only newly scaffolded apps are affected.

title: createKumikoServer/runDevApp take ExtraRouteDefinition[]; dev hostDispatch gets systemQuery
migration: extraRoutes on createKumikoServer/runDevApp changes from (app, deps) => void to readonly ExtraRouteDefinition[] - see the framework core changelog entry for the route-kind/dep breakdown. wire?: (deps: SystemWireDeps) => void | Promise<void> replaces non-route setup previously done inside the old extraRoutes callback. The dev hostDispatch callback now receives a second argument { systemQuery }; a dispatch implementation reading the dev db directly switches to systemQuery.

title: renderWriteHandlerTypes emits the WriteHandlerQn union in stable order
detail: `renderWriteHandlerTypes` now sorts `handlerQns` before rendering, like its sibling renderers in the same file. The dev-server passes registration order (`collectWriteHandlerQns`) while the CLI/build path passes manifest order, so the same feature set produced a differently ordered `WriteHandlerQn` union in `.kumiko/define.ts` and `.kumiko/types.generated.d.ts` depending on which one ran last. Consumer apps that commit those generated files no longer get order-only diffs after a local `bun dev`.

title: runDevApp gains resolvePageHead for dev/e2e parity with runProdApp
detail: RunDevAppOptions/CreateKumikoServerOptions gain resolvePageHead, same PageHeadResolver signature as RunProdAppOptions. Applied to every templated HTML response (default single-entry shell and a host-dispatched "html" entry) via the shared @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless/apex resolveAndInjectPageHead — same 300ms timeout, same error/null/timeout-falls-back-to-unchanged-200-shell semantics as prod (kumiko-framework#3026). The dev-only static-html hostDispatch kind (raw file passthrough, no bundle/schema injection either) is unaffected. No behavior change for apps that don't set resolvePageHead.
